finding_info.desc: Financial entities shall develop and document backup policies and procedures specifying the scope of data subject to backup and the minimum frequency of the backup, as well as restoration and recovery procedures and methods. finding_info.desc: Financial entities shall continuously monitor and control the security and functioning of ICT systems and tools and minimise the impact of ICT risk by deploying appropriate ICT security tools, policies and procedures. Encryption at rest and in transit, blocking of public exposure, network access controls, secret management and instance hardening are central to this article.
finding_info.title: DORA-Art9

checks.desc: **RDS DB instances** are assessed for **internet exposure** using the `PubliclyAccessible` setting, security group ingress to the DB port from any address, and whether subnets are **public**. Instances that combine an internet-facing endpoint, open ingress, and public subnets are identified.

checks.desc: **RDS DB instances** and **DB clusters** enforce **SSL/TLS** for client connections via parameter groups. finding_info.desc: Financial entities shall develop and document backup policies and procedures specifying the scope of data subject to backup and the minimum frequency of the backup, as well as restoration and recovery procedures and methods. message: RDS Instance securenotes-demo-db is not publicly accessible.
status_detail: RDS Instance securenotes-demo-db is not publicly accessible.

finding_info.desc: Financial entities shall continuously monitor and control the security and functioning of ICT systems and tools and minimise the impact of ICT risk by deploying appropriate ICT security tools, policies and procedures. Encryption at rest and in transit, blocking of public exposure, network access controls, secret management and instance hardening are central to this article.
finding_info.title: DORA-Art9

checks.desc: **RDS DB instances** are assessed for **internet exposure** using the `PubliclyAccessible` setting, security group ingress to the DB port from any address, and whether subnets are **public**. Instances that combine an internet-facing endpoint, open ingress, and public subnets are identified.
